{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will aggressively enforce non-discrimination protections in the Americans with Disabilities Act and other civil rights laws, especially when designing emergency management systems and new facilities and services in response to the pandemic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prohibit unjustified segregation of patients with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prohibit rationing of health care that refuses or diverts hospitalization, treatment, or supplies based on a patient's disability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People with disabilities living in group homes and other care facilities are at greater risk of contracting COVID-19.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People with disabilities may require additional resources to protect their health, well-being, and independence during the pandemic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will improve oversight and expand protections for residents and staff at nursing homes, which have seen some of the worst COVID-19 outbreaks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand support for telemedicine, so Americans do not have to go without essential health care during the pandemic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
